body: Some data cells can be 2M or so large, which isn't great, considering this is just proto3 data, written once, rarely read. They should be compressed by default, perhaps with some minimum size that is worth the effort. Example from a production workload: It seems I can use this: ```Golang The PayloadCodec interface: type PayloadCodec interface { Encode(payloads []*commonpb.Payload) ([]*commonpb.Payload, error) Decode(payloads []*commonpb.Payload) ([]*commonpb.Payload, error) } ``` If approved, I'll give it a try.
title: Compress history_node->data cell
